channel.title: Religion News Service - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: Lawns light up for Ramadan as Muslim families give holy month the Christmas treatment
item.description: Outdoor displays once reserved almost exclusively for Christmas are now lighting up lawns during the Islamic month of fasting.

item.title: Two new DC congregations cater to Black Jews
item.description: Jews of color continue to face barriers to full inclusion in the Jewish community. Now they are forming their own worship communities.

item.title: Syria’s TV dramas are testing Ramadan series’ boundaries after Assad’s fall
item.description: As the country emerges from 14 years of civil war, more than a year after Islamist-led insurgents brought the authoritarian Assad dynasty to an end, Syria’s TV industry is seeking its footing in the new order.

item.title: Supporters of jailed Ugandan opposition figure pray for him after president tries to stop it
item.description: The event was the first of its kind in support of Kizza Besigye, who has sometimes appeared in court in a wheelchair. He has been repeatedly denied bail, even as many Ugandans urge compassion. His trial is yet to formally start.

item.title: Religious ties shape how Black Americans define family, Pew study finds
item.description: Black Christians are more likely than religiously unaffiliated to consider nonrelatives a part of their families.

item.title: Photos of the Week: Dalai Lama longevity; St. Francis death anniversary
item.description: This week’s photo selection includes prayers for the Dalai Lama's longevity, the 800th death anniversary of St. Francis and more.

item.title: Tucker Carlson hears two evangelical Christian views on Israel. Which leads to peace?
item.description: back interviews by Carlson revealed a growing chasm within American evangelical Christianity over U.S. support for Israel.

item.title: HistoryIT acquires LifeWeb 360 and launches MemoryPort to help organizations capture and share member legacies
Shooting incidents unsettle Muslims as Ramadan begins
item.description: Muslim advocates have warned that recent Islamophobic rhetoric from national political leaders can make targets of community members and their houses of worship.

item.title: Hundreds of United Methodists rally to dismantle ICE outside Capitol
item.description: ‘We demand that ICE and CBP be dismantled,’ said retired United Methodist Bishop Minerva Garza Carcaño at the rally.
